description.value:
You imbue a willing creature with an acute foresight that sharpens its reflexes just before danger strikes. For the duration, the target gains a +1 status bonus to initiative rolls. Additionally, once during the duration, the target can invoke the foresight as a free action at the start of a combat to roll initiative twice and take the higher result (the fortune trait applies; additional fortune effects cannot further alter the roll). Once the fortune effect is used, only the +1 status bonus remains. If you Cast this Spell again, any prior casting of it ends.

Heightened (3rd) The status bonus to initiative increases to +2, and the fortune re-roll can be used twice instead of once.
